mapper.insert: INSERT INTO inventory_balance (warehouse_id, sku_id, unit, quantity, version, deleted, created_at, updated_at, created_by, updated_by) VALUES (#{warehouseId}, #{skuId}, #{unit}, 0, 0, FALSE, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, #{operator}, #{operator}) ON CONFLICT (warehouse_id, sku_id) WHERE deleted = FALSE DO NOTHING
mapper.update: UPDATE inventory_balance SET quantity = quantity + #{quantity}, version = version + 1, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, updated_by = #{operator} WHERE id = #{id} AND deleted = FALSE
UPDATE inventory_balance SET quantity = quantity - #{quantity}, version = version + 1, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, updated_by = #{operator} WHERE id = #{id} AND deleted = FALSE
UPDATE inventory_balance SET reserved_quantity = reserved_quantity + #{quantity}, version = version + 1, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, updated_by = #{operator} WHERE id = #{id} AND deleted = FALSE
UPDATE inventory_balance SET reserved_quantity = reserved_quantity - #{quantity}, version = version + 1, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, updated_by = #{operator} WHERE id = #{id} AND deleted = FALSE

UPDATE inventory_balance SET quantity = quantity + #{quantity}, avg_cost = #{avgCost}, version = version + 1, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, updated_by = #{operator} WHERE id = #{id} AND deleted = FALSE
mapper.select:
SELECT b.id, b.warehouse_id, b.sku_id, b.unit, b.quantity, b.reserved_quantity, b.avg_cost,
ROUND(b.quantity * b.avg_cost, 2) AS amount, b.version, b.updated_at, w.warehouse_code, w.name AS warehouse_name, k.sku_code, k.spec_name AS sku_name, k.spec_values, p.name AS product_name FROM inventory_balance b LEFT JOIN warehouse w ON w.id = b.warehouse_id LEFT JOIN product_sku k ON k.id = b.sku_id LEFT JOIN product_spu p ON p.id = k.spu_id WHERE b.deleted = FALSE
AND b.warehouse_id = #{query.warehouseId}
AND b.sku_id = #{query.skuId}
AND k.sku_code ILIKE CONCAT('%', #{query.skuCode}, '%')
AND p.name ILIKE CONCAT('%', #{query.productName}, '%')
ORDER BY b.updated_at DESC, b.id DESC

SELECT b.id, b.warehouse_id, b.sku_id, b.unit, b.quantity, b.reserved_quantity, b.avg_cost,
ROUND(b.quantity * b.avg_cost, 2) AS amount, b.version, b.updated_at, w.warehouse_code, w.name AS warehouse_name, k.sku_code, k.spec_name AS sku_name, k.spec_values, p.name AS product_name FROM inventory_balance b LEFT JOIN warehouse w ON w.id = b.warehouse_id LEFT JOIN product_sku k ON k.id = b.sku_id LEFT JOIN product_spu p ON p.id = k.spu_id WHERE b.deleted = FALSE AND b.id = #{id}
